diagrams.label: Wiring Schematic - Vulcan OmniPro 220 (Item 57812)
diagrams.spatial: Top-left shows OUT+ and OUT- output terminals connected to the main power circuit. Left side contains the main power stage including rectifier, PFC (Power Factor Correction) circuit with IGBT, transformer/inductor components, and diode bridges. Center-left area contains the PFC board and IGBT module. Center-right contains the MCU BOARD with multiple connector ports (CN1-CN9, CNT). Top-center-right shows the LCD SCREEN connected to the MCU BOARD. Bottom-left shows the AC input section labeled K1 AC 120-240V/50/60HZ with AC1, AC2, and Ground (G) connections. Bottom-center shows FAN and FAN2 connections. Right side shows SOLENOID VALVE (x2), WIRE FEEDER motor (M), and two AVIATION PLUG connectors. Bottom-right area contains the REMOTE BOARD. Bottom-right corner shows two large circular components representing the cooling fans.

key_facts: The welder accepts AC input voltage of 120-240V at 50/60Hz
The unit uses a PFC (Power Factor Correction) circuit
The unit uses IGBT switching transistors in the power stage
Two solenoid valves are present in the circuit
A wire feeder motor (M) is controlled via the MCU BOARD
The MCU BOARD has multiple connectors labeled CN1 through CN9 plus CNT and CNS
Two cooling fans (FAN and FAN2) are present
Two aviation plugs are used for external connections (likely torch and remote)
A REMOTE BOARD is included for remote control functionality
A FAST WIRE FEED SWITCH is connected to the MCU BOARD
An LCD SCREEN is connected to the MCU BOARD
The rectifier converts AC input to DC for the power stage
